messages:
maria_cs: FYI — BeaconX's Insights org just requested to add a new Analytics team next month. They want realtime call-summary + per-conversation embeddings. Probable QPS spike, asking if we can support a pilot with higher throughput and short-term dedicated capacity :eyes:
jamie_csm: Thanks for the heads-up. Any numbers from the customer on expected volume?
eric_se: From the quick scope call: they expect ~120 concurrent summarization streams, ~30k short requests/day, roughly 1.2M tokens/day. They want 50ms tail for summaries where possible.
jamie_csm: Noted. Also they care about EU data residency — wants routing to eu-west region for PII workflows.
sarah_support: Are they using streaming responses or batch? Streaming will change the batching profile a lot.
eric_se: Streaming for summaries, embeddings are batched (async). They'll test both. They plan to run a 2-week pilot and then scale.
alex_sales: This could convert to a Dedicated contract if pilot hits SLA + cost targets. Renewal conversation in 7 weeks — strong incentive to make pilot smooth.
maria_cs: Flagging a potential renewal risk if latency or token cost blows up. Can eng help size a short dedicated pilot (e.g., 1 GPU pool with autoscale to 2)?
eric_se: I can run an initial perf sim tomorrow. Quick config suggestion for pilot: 
```
model: redwood-large-v2
region: eu-west-1
batching: dynamic
kv_cache: enabled
autoscale_min: 1
autoscale_max: 2
```
That should cover 120 concurrent streams with prefix caching.
ops_bot: quota-bot: note — current BeaconX hosted usage baseline: 250k tokens/day. Proposed pilot adds ~1.2M tokens/day. Please submit capacity request form: https://redwood/capacity-request
jamie_csm: I'll open the capacity request and schedule enablement. Can we also get an enablement playbook for their SREs (how to read Console dashboards, cost breakdown, and fallback wiring)?
eric_se: I'll draft the short playbook. Also want to run a quick regression eval on summary quality vs. quantized variants — might recommend int8 for cost but need QA.
sarah_support: I'll set up a 30-min troubleshooting session during week 1 of pilot. Any specific observability to enable?
eric_se: Enable token-level latency, per-route cost, and KV hit rate. Add a canary route to fall back to a cheaper model when latency >200ms.
alex_sales: I'll loop in AM + renewals to prioritize. If pilot looks good, we estimate a $60-80k ARR bump in 12 months (conservative).
maria_cs: Action items: jamie open capacity request (in progress), eric draft playbook + perf sim (tomorrow), sarah setup troubleshooting slot, alex notify renewals. I'll follow up with BeaconX to set pilot start date.
jamie_csm: opened ticket 2781234 — added initial numbers and EU region requirement. ping @eric_se for perf sim.
eric_se: Got it. Running sim now, will post results in this thread before EOD.
maria_cs: Thanks — this is a high-priority expansion signal. Let's avoid surprises on cost + latency. :thumbsup:
ops_bot: deploy-bot: reminder — any dedicated pilot requiring GPUs needs a lead time of 48 hours to provision if approved.
alex_sales: We'll tell the customer a soft start window of two weeks to allow provisioning.
jamie_csm: Quick note for docs: BeaconX wants anonymization at ingest. Add the privacy controls checklist to the enablement playbook.
eric_se: Adding checklist. Also recommending prefix/KV cache TTL=30s for ephemeral call contexts to maximize reuse.
sarah_support: Alright, I have the troubleshooting slot set for Tuesday 10:00 CET. Invite sent to BeaconX SREs.
maria_cs: Great work team. Keep thread updated with perf sim numbers and capacity request status.
eric_se: Perf sim: 120 streams -> 45ms median, 210ms p99 with current single-GPU config. With autoscale_max=2 p99 drops to 90ms. Posting detailed logs shortly.
jamie_csm: Adding that to capacity ticket. This looks like a viable pilot.
alex_sales: Awesome — will prepare preliminary term sheet pending pilot success metrics.
maria_cs: Closing note: capture any customer feedback about summary fidelity during pilot; product wants concrete examples for evaluation.
